sourceText: After B-19ca, solve routine validate fresh-PASS reuse before roadmap #2/#3: unchanged material with an already successful command suite must reuse instead of rerunning, especially after verification evidence refresh; any meaningful identity change must execute.
normalizedOutcome: A repeated ordinary validation on unchanged clean material returns an auditable reused PASS with zero command executions after current coverage becomes complete, while changed or uncertain inputs execute the real plan.
acceptanceClaim: A B-19ca regression runs the command plan once, records commandExecution PASS with stale coverage, refreshes only verificationEvidence, then the next validation reports disposition=reused and commandExecutions=0 with no evidence or HEAD write.
